snp1.7:1.1: Vasalasutta. Evam me sutaṃ: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme. Atha kho Bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya Sāvatthiṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi. Tena kho pana samayena Aggikabhāradvājassa brāhmaṇassa nivesane aggi pajjalito hoti, āhutī paggahitā. Atha kho Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ sapasānaṃ piṇḍāya caramāno yena Aggikaghāradvājassa brāhmaṇassa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṃkami.
snp1.7:2.1: Addasā kho Aggikabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ dūrato va āgacchantaṃ, disvāna Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca: "tatr' eva muṇḍaka, tatr' eva samanaka, tatr' eva vasalaka tiṭṭhāhī" ti.
snp1.7:3.1: Evaṃ vutte Bhagavā Aggikabhāradvājaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etad avoca: "jānāsi pana tvaṃ brāhmaṇa vasalaṃ vā vasalakaraṇe vā dhamme" ti. "Na khv-āhaṃ bho Gotama jānami vasalaṃ vā vasalakaraṇe vā dhamme, sādhu me bhavaṃ Gotamo tathā dhammaṃ desetu, yathāhaṃ jāneyyaṃ vasalaṃ vā vasalakaraṇe vā dhamme" ti. "Tena hi brāhmaṇa suṇāhi, sādhukaṃ manasikarohi, bhāsissāmī" ti. "Evam bho" ti kho Aggikabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo Bhagavato paccassosi. Bhagavā etad avoca:
snp1.7:4.1: "Kodhano upanāhī ca pāpamakkhi ca yo naro vipannadiṭṭhi māyāvī, taṃ jaññā ‘vassalo' iti. || ||
snp1.7:5.1: Ekajaṃ vā dijaṃ va pi yo 'dha pāṇāṇi hiṃsati, yassa pāṇe dayā n' atthi, taṃ jaññā ‘vasalo' iti. || ||
snp1.7:6.1: Yo hanti parirundhati gāmāni nigamāni ca niggāhako samaññāto, taṃ jaññā ‘vasalo' iti. || ||
snp1.7:7.1: Gāme vā yadi vāraññe yaṃ paresaṃ mamāyitaṃ theyyā adinnaṃ ādiyati, taṃ jaññā --pe-- || || Yo have iṇam
snp1.7:8.1: ādāya cujjamāno palāyati "na hi te iṇam atthī" ti, taṃ jaññā . . . || || Yo ve kiñcikkhakamyatā
snp1.7:9.1: panthasmiṃ vajataṃ janaṃ hantvā kiñcikkham ādeti, taṃ jaññā . . . || || Yo attahetu
snp1.7:10.1: parahetu dhanahetu ca yo naro sakkhipuṭṭho musā brūhi, taṃ jaññā . . . || || Yo ñātīnaṃ
snp1.7:11.1: sakhānaṃ vā dāresu patidissati sahasā sampiyena vā, taṃ jaññā . . . || || Yo mātaraṃ
snp1.7:12.1: vā pitaraṃ vā jiṇṇakaṃ gatayobbanaṃ pahu santo na bharati, taṃ jaññā . . . || || Yo mātaraṃ
snp1.7:13.1: vā pitaraṃ vā bhātaraṃ bhaginiṃ sasuṃ hanti roseti vācāya, taṃ jaññā . . . || || Yo atthaṃ pucchito
snp1.7:14.1: santo anattham anusāsati, paṭicchannena manteti, taṃ jaññā . . . || || Yo katvā pāpakaṃ
snp1.7:15.1: kammaṃ ‘mā maṃ jaññā' ti icchati, yo paṭicchannakammanto, taṃ jaññā . . . || || Yo ve parakulaṃ
snp1.7:16.1: gantvā bhutvāna sucibhojanaṃ āgataṃ na paṭipūjeti, taṃ jaññā . . . || || Yo brāhmaṇaṃ
snp1.7:17.1: vā samaṇaṃ vā aññaṃ vā pi vaṇibbakaṃ musāvādena vañceti, taṃ jaññā . . . || || Yo brāhmaṇaṃ
snp1.7:18.1: vā samaṇaṃ vā bhattakāle upaṭṭhite roseti vācā na ca deti, taṃ jaññā . . . || || Asataṃ
snp1.7:19.1: yo 'dha pa brūti mohena paliguṇṭhito kiñcikkhaṃ nijigiṃsāno, taṃ jaññā . . . || || Yo c' attānaṃ
snp1.7:20.1: samukkaṃse parañ ca-m-avajānati, nihīno sena mānena, taṃ jaññā . . . || || Rosako kadariyo
snp1.7:21.1: ca pāpiccho maccharī saṭho ahiriko anottāpī, taṃ jaññā . . . || || Yo buddhaṃ
snp1.7:22.1: paribhāsati atha vā tassa sāvakaṃ paribbājaṃ gahaṭṭhaṃ vā, taṃ jaññā . . . || || Yo ve anarahā
snp1.7:23.1: santo arahaṃ paṭijānati coro sabrahmake loke, esa kho vasalādhamo. Ete kho vasalā vuttā, mayā vo ye pakāsitā. || ||
snp1.7:24.1: Na jaccā vasalo hoti, na jaccā hoti brāhmaṇo, kammanā vasalo hoti, kammanā hoti brāhmaṇo. || ||
snp1.7:25.1: Tad aminā pi jānātha, yathā me 'daṃ nidassanaṃ: caṇḍālaputto sopāko Mātaṅgo iti vissuto, || ||
snp1.7:26.1: so yasaṃ paramaṃ patto Mātaṅgo yaṃ sudullabhaṃ, āgañchuṃ tass' upaṭṭhānaṃ khattiyā brāhmaṇā bahū. || || So
snp1.7:27.1: devayānam āruyha, virajaṃ so mahāpathaṃ, kāmarāgaṃ virājetvā brahmalokūpago ahu, -- na naṃ jāti nivāresi brahmalokūpapattiyā. || ||
snp1.7:28.1: Ajjhāyakakule jātā brāhmaṇā mantabandhavā, te ca pāpesu kammesu abhiṇham upadissare, || ||
snp1.7:29.1: diṭṭhe va dhamme gārayhā, samparāye ca duggati --, na ne jāti nivāreti duggaccā garahāya vā || ||
snp1.7:30.1: Na jaccā vasalo hoti, na jaccā hoti brāhmaṇo, kammanā vasalo hoti, kammanā hoti brāhmaṇo" ti.
